# Per-Example Predictive Multiplicity in Hybrid Linear Recurrent Architectures

Code and data for the paper submitted to EMNLP 2026 (via ARR).

## Overview

This repository contains analysis code, figure generation scripts, and per-example evaluation data for studying predictive multiplicity across hybrid recurrent architectures (GatedDeltaNet, RetNet, HGRN2, GLA, DeltaNet) using the model zoo of [Wang et al. (2025)](https://huggingface.co/collections/thinkonward/hydra-model-zoo-67b67c53c908fb6331d53ed4).

## Repository Structure

```
├── paper/                  # LaTeX source
│   ├── main.tex           # Entry point
│   ├── sections/          # Paper sections
│   ├── figures/           # Compiled figure PDFs
│   └── references.bib     # Bibliography
├── analysis/              # Analysis scripts
│   ├── analyze_per_example.py          # Per-example helped/hurt decomposition
│   ├── analyze_6arch.py                # 5-architecture extension analysis
│   ├── a2_prediction_framework.py      # Confidence-margin prediction (AUC, routing)
│   ├── analysis_majority_vote_and_rho.py  # Majority vote + Spearman convergence
│   ├── e2_continuous_jaccard.py        # Continuous Jaccard under confidence thresholds
│   ├── e3_calibration.py              # Pythia seed calibration baseline
│   ├── eval_composition.py            # lm-eval-harness evaluation composition
│   ├── extract_attention_weights.py   # Attention weight extraction + cosine similarity
│   ├── sample_characterization.py     # Sample-level feature characterization
│   └── exp011_convergence_analysis.py # Within-architecture convergence
├── figures/               # Figure generation scripts
│   ├── gen_fig1.py        # Figure 1: Decoupling hero (aggregate σ vs Jaccard)
│   ├── gen_fig2.py        # Figure 2: Task specificity (Spearman ρ forest plot)
│   └── gen_fig3_alpha_routing.py  # α spectrum + routing visualization
├── scripts/experiments/   # Experiment runner scripts
│   ├── run_priority1_v2.sh
│   ├── run_priority1_v3.sh
│   └── run_priority2.sh
├── data/                  # Pre-computed analysis outputs (JSON/CSV)
└── requirements.txt
```

## Models

All models are from the publicly available [Hydra Model Zoo](https://huggingface.co/collections/thinkonward/hydra-model-zoo-67b67c53c908fb6331d53ed4) by Wang et al. (2025). The zoo provides 30 configurations: 3 architectures (GatedDeltaNet, RetNet, HGRN2) x 5 attention ratios (0%, 4%, 8%, 12.5%, 25%) x 2 scales (340M, 1.3B). Extended validation uses GLA and DeltaNet at 340M.

## Requirements

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Reproducing Results

### 1. Evaluation

Run lm-eval-harness on each model checkpoint:

```bash
lm_eval --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=<model_path>,trust_remote_code=True \
    --tasks lambada_openai,hellaswag,piqa,arc_easy,arc_challenge,boolq,winogrande,mmlu,sciq,xstorycloze_en \
    --batch_size auto \
    --log_samples \
    --output_path ./results/<model_name>
```

The `--log_samples` flag is required to obtain per-example predictions.

### 2. Per-Example Analysis

```bash
python analysis/analyze_per_example.py
```

### 3. Figure Generation

```bash
python figures/gen_fig1.py
python figures/gen_fig2.py
```

### 4. Extended Analyses

```bash
python analysis/a2_prediction_framework.py    # Confidence-margin prediction
python analysis/e2_continuous_jaccard.py       # Continuous Jaccard
python analysis/e3_calibration.py              # Seed calibration baseline
python analysis/analyze_6arch.py               # 5-architecture extension
```

## Data

The `data/` directory contains pre-computed analysis outputs (JSON/CSV) for all results reported in the paper, enabling verification without re-running evaluations.
